Class CareerServiceController

java.lang.Object
project.CareerServiceController
All Implemented Interfaces:
FilterOptions
public class CareerServiceController extends Object implements FilterOptions
Controller class for Career Service Staff operations. Handles company registration, approval/rejection of companies and internships, and processing of student withdrawal requests.
